name: Adobe Photoshop API
description: Photoshop automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io/pie/psdService): a PhotoshopAutomationPort + adapter for Smart Object replacement, text-layer edits, action JSON, crop, and PSD rendering over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async; inputs are named layers in a pre-authored .psd.

questions.prompt: Which Photoshop operations will you use?

checklist: Confirm the Photoshop API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)
Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — the Photoshop API lives on image.adobe.io/pie/psdService (a different host than firefly-api.adobe.io; the client posts absolute URLs there)
Your input .psd MUST contain named Smart Object / text layers — smartObject/editTextLayer target layers by name and fail if they are absent
Provide presigned input (.psd), replacement-image, and output hrefs — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
renderPsd output format defaults to ADOBE_PHOTOSHOP_FORMAT (set at install); override per call
